effect.fr: Tenu: Utilisé pour soigner l'amour. Gén V : Supprime aussi Provoc, Encore, Tourmente, Entrave, et Corps Maudit.
effect.en: Held: Consumed to cure infatuation. Gen V: Also removes Taunt, Encore, Torment, Disable, and Cursed Body.

flavor.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder shakes off move-binding effects to move freely. It can be used only once.
flavor.ko: 지니게 한 포켓몬은 헤롱헤롱 상태가 되었을 때 한 번만 회복한다.
flavor.ja: 持たせた ポケモンが 自由に 技を だせなくなったときに １度だけ 回復する。
